NOEAPPS / SUPPORT

Support

Get help with NoeApps products and Atlassian Marketplace apps.

Contact support

Email: support@noeapps.com.

For security reports, contact security@noeapps.com.

When contacting support, include the app or product name, a concise description of the issue, the approximate time it occurred, the steps needed to reproduce it, and screenshots when useful. Do not send passwords, API tokens, access keys, or other secrets.

Support hours

Monday to Friday, 09:00–18:00 Europe/Madrid, excluding public holidays in Spain.

Critical and high-priority requests receive an initial response within 1 business day. Other support requests receive an initial response within 2 business days.

Service levels

See the public NoeApps Support Service Level Agreement (SLA) for severity definitions, response targets, availability information, and escalation details.
